import html # Predefined HTML template for a forum post. # The placeholders {title}, {body} and {points} will be replaced # with the sanitized content. FORUM_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}

Discussion Points

    {points}
""" def create_forum_entry(title: str, body: str, points: list[str]) -> str: """ Assemble a sanitized forum post from user supplied content. Parameters ---------- title : str The title or main topic of the forum post. body : str The primary content or body text of the post. points : list[str] A series of user-supplied discussion points or options in markdown format. Returns ------- str A fully formatted and sanitized forum post ready for HTML rendering. """ # Escape all user-provided strings to prevent XSS (CWE-79) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=False) # Build the list items for discussion points safe_points = [] for point in points: # Escape each point individually escaped_point = html.escape(point, quote=False) safe_points.append(f"
  • {escaped_point}
    • ") points_html = "\n ".join(safe_points) # Format the final HTML using the template formatted_post = FORUM_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, body=safe_body, points=points_html ) return formatted_post.strip()
